commits.summary: Freeze six historical public callers (verification pending)
commits.body:
The ordinary JVM reproduced the Spring authority sets, accessor and date histories, 400 Javaslang matrices, 902 zero-tolerance search inputs and the exact decimal outcomes. The builder exists only on the newer artifacts. The source-slice route binds the historical formatter ahead of its release copy on the actual JVM. The original JUnit method, compiled unchanged against each slice, failed on the parent and passed on the fix. All six replays and offline plans passed, as did 59 changed-test groups.

Managed jobs 20261122-162529-spring-security-reachable-roles-and-publ, 20261122-162530-vavr-matrix-coordinates-and-ragged-rejec, 20261122-162530-spring-accessor-names-on-paired-method-m, 20261122-162530-first-nan-and-preserved-numbers-at-zero, 20261122-162530-spring-formatter-precedence-and-repeated, 20261122-162530-decimal-result-class-coefficient-scale-a and 20261122-162530-run-spring-s-original-formatter-preceden retain the individual results.
